title: Concept: Framework SQL built from input (drupal) — review required
description: In drupal, db_querys*([^)]*(?:"[^"n]*$|.s*$) mixes SQL text with values. ORM and helper layers pass interpolated text straight to the driver. The remedy is bound parameters via :placeholder args.
applicability: drupal data calls; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Full database compromise when untrusted input reaches the query; HIGH severity.
